items.title: Years of Documented Work
items.desc: Documented field experience in Gaza, Syria, Chad, Sudan, and Egypt over more than 5 years.

items.q: Is the sacrifice valid through proxy?
items.a: Yes, proxy in sacrifice is permissible by scholarly consensus, and the ritual is performed at the correct canonical time.

items.q: Where exactly is my sacrifice performed?
items.a: It varies by pathway: Pathway 1 in Africa, Pathway 2 in Sudan or India then shipped to Gaza, and Pathway 3 in the country you select from the list.

items.q: How do I know the sacrifice was distributed?
items.a: We send you a confirmation message with an order number, and field photos and videos can be attached post-execution depending on the region's circumstances.

items.q: Can I sacrifice on behalf of someone else?
items.a: Yes, write the person's name or intention in the "Intent / Names" field in the form.
The remaining time is shown in the countdown at the top of the page and near the donation form. Registration closes just before the days of sacrifice.

items.q: What if execution is not possible?
items.a: We notify you immediately and work to find an alternative pathway, or return your full donation — trust comes first.
